description: This source file defines a CameraController actor for managing camera and microphone access, capturing photos and videos, and handling related errors and device discovery on iOS using AVFoundation. It includes classes for capturing photos and videos, error handling, and device management.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for handling photo capture callbacks from AVCapturePhotoOutput, resuming a continuation with the captured photo data or error.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for handling video recording completion callbacks, resuming a continuation with the recorded file URL or error.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo with specified parameters asynchronously, returning image format, base64-encoded data, width, and height.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip asynchronously with specified parameters and returns format, base64 data, duration, and audio presence.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available camera devices with their IDs, names, positions, and device types.
